checking_content:
Full-screen WebGL particle simulation
Preconditions: Page loaded on desktop.
Steps:
  1. Observe the viewport. -> expected: A full-screen 3D scene renders thousands of small glowing particles flowing like smoke or a ghost above a dark metallic floor that reflects them, with scene fog and soft shadows.
Pass: Dense animated particle flow is visible over a reflective floor with no blank canvas or error overlay.
expected_result: Dense animated particle flow is visible over a reflective floor with no blank canvas or error overlay.

checking_content:
Mouse-following attraction
Preconditions: Simulation running.
Steps:
  1. Move the mouse across the canvas and hold it in one area. -> expected: The particle stream bends toward and swirls around the mouse position, forming a visible attraction point.
Pass: Particles visibly follow the cursor and gather near it while it moves.
expected_result: Particles visibly follow the cursor and gather near it while it moves.

checking_content:
Spacebar movement toggle
Preconditions: Page focused, instruction hint visible.
Steps:
  1. Note the bottom hint text ('Press space key to toggle movement'), then press Space. -> expected: The particles' motion pauses or resumes accordingly.
Pass: Pressing Space toggles the simulation movement and the hint text is present at the bottom.
expected_result: Pressing Space toggles the simulation movement and the hint text is present at the bottom.

checking_content:
Entrance animation of logo and footer
Preconditions: Page just loaded.
Steps:
  1. Observe the overlay elements during the first seconds. -> expected: The logo fades in with a scale/blur animation (positioned right on wide screens), while the footer links and instruction text slide up with staggered timing.
Pass: Logo and footer/instruction elements animate in smoothly and end up fully visible.
expected_result: Logo and footer/instruction elements animate in smoothly and end up fully visible.

checking_content:
Footer links row
Preconditions: Entrance animation finished.
Steps:
  1. Inspect the bottom-right corner. -> expected: Links to the author's website (Edan Kwan), the GitHub repository, and the YouTube video are present and clickable.
Pass: All three footer links are visible with meaningful labels.
expected_result: All three footer links are visible with meaningful labels.

checking_content:
Simulator settings folder
Preconditions: dat.GUI panel visible.
Steps:
  1. Open the Simulator folder and adjust speed, radius, curl size or attraction, and toggle follow-mouse. -> expected: The panel exposes these simulation controls and adjusting them produces visible changes in particle behavior (speed, spread, curl, attraction).
Pass: Simulator controls exist and at least one adjustment visibly alters the particle motion.
expected_result: Simulator controls exist and at least one adjustment visibly alters the particle motion.

checking_content:
Rendering settings folder
Preconditions: dat.GUI panel visible.
Steps:
  1. Open the Rendering folder and change the base color, fade color or background color. -> expected: The particle colors and/or scene background change immediately and smoothly.
Pass: Color controls produce visible recoloring of the particles or background.
expected_result: Color controls produce visible recoloring of the particles or background.

checking_content:
Post-processing toggles
Preconditions: dat.GUI panel visible.
Steps:
  1. Toggle FXAA, motion blur and bloom in the Post-Processing folder. -> expected: Each toggle changes the final image (sharper/softer edges, motion trails, glow).
Pass: Post-processing toggles produce distinguishable visual differences.
expected_result: Post-processing toggles produce distinguishable visual differences.

checking_content:
Orbit camera constraints
Preconditions: Simulation running.
Steps:
  1. Left-drag to rotate the view and scroll to zoom. -> expected: Rotation orbits around the particle formation, zoom is limited to a sane range, and panning does not wander the target off center.
Pass: Camera orbit/zoom behave smoothly and stay constrained without disorienting panning.
expected_result: Camera orbit/zoom behave smoothly and stay constrained without disorienting panning.
